role_voices.text_zh: 願悔者蒙神寬恕；願惡者歸於塵土。
role_voices.text_en: May the repentant be forgiven by God; may the wicked return to dust.

role_voices.text_zh: 讓神聖的銀光淨化你們的罪孽！
role_voices.text_en: Let the holy silver light purify your sins!

role_voices.text_zh: 讚美神的慈悲，敬畏神的威光……
role_voices.text_en: Praise God's mercy, and revere His glorious might...
Repent to God! Gates of Heaven!

role_voices.text_zh: 對不起了，朋友們。我要先你們一步…步入天堂了……
role_voices.text_en: I'm sorry, my friends. I'll be taking a step ahead of you... into heaven...

role_voices.text_zh: 聽從神的指引而來……久等了，我的朋友們。
role_voices.text_en: I have come, following the guidance of the gods... My friends, I have kept you waiting.
